verdict.rationale: Navan is a SaaS travel and expense platform, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair question to ask of it. None of the evidence mentions data residency, region selection, or storage location. The MCP, API, and pricing docs describe other capabilities, and none of them speak to where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
